name: Lobster theme
description: Lobster look for the OpenClaw Control UI.

themes.name: Lobster
themes.description: Ember shell orange and bioluminescent teal on deep-sea black, with a sun-bleached sand light mode, Space Grotesk controls, and Fraunces serif chat. One large line-art lobster across the canvas, faint shell fills, and a composer whose top corners scoop like pincer tips. Calm, briny, and quietly crustacean.
